blocks.text: SEOUL, South Korea — South Korea’s government said a suspected North Korean aircraft had breached its airspace near a small eastern island on Tuesday after ordering residents to head to shelters. The Ministry of the Interior and Safety initially reported that a Russian aircraft had breached South Korean airspace and told residents of Ulleung Island to move to underground facilities or take shelter inside buildings. READ: North Korea’s Kim says country seeks security, not supremacy The government later lifted the evacuation order, and later revised its assessment to describe the aircraft as possibly being North Korean.
